name: Oozora Himawari
source:
The middle sister of the three Oozora sisters. She is an authentic girl who delivers energy and good weather.

The girls in this game are exceptionally whip-cracking, but this is only the beginning of the story.

She is one of the mascot's from Otenki Studio. She is 22 years old.

[From [url=https://www.konbuni.com/nangoku.html]official site[/url]]
